summary: Comprehensive frontend-only Playwright test of the Portuguese personal finance dashboard (localStorage-based). All 13 listed flows passed: onboarding with empty-name validation, dashboard greeting, currency switching (header + onboarding), salary input + formatted display, allocation sliders with sum-100% warning, 4 budget cards, add-expense validation + success, expense list + count + remaining balance, delete expense, month picker (prev/next) with per-month data persistence, monthly report (pie + bar + month picker), localStorage persistence across reload, and reset (with native confirm) returning to onboarding. No functional issues found.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from a dev-only visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text — not present in source code (option children are plain strings). No user-visible impact; safe to ignore.

Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial mount before ResponsiveContainer measures parent. Charts render correctly after layout; cosmetic console noise only. Could be silenced by giving the chart wrappers an explicit minHeight.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.handleChangeMonth seeds the new month inside a setState updater but also calls setActiveMonth outside — works due to React batching but it would be cleaner to keep state derivation pure (avoid reading prev.months[activeMonth] inside the updater while also relying on activeMonth closure).

AllocationCard treats total === 100 strictly with integers, which is correct here, but if non-integer inputs were ever introduced floating-point comparison would break — keep parseInt as-is or add a tolerance.
ExpensesList.formatDate uses 'pt-BR' locale hardcoded; acceptable for a Portuguese app but inconsistent with multi-currency support if i18n is added later.
MonthlyReport useEffect with empty deps disables exhaustive-deps; fine for one-time fallback, but documenting intent would help.
No unit/integration tests committed — pure UI; acceptable for an MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test created an expense (Mercado R$ 250 / Necessidades) and a salary of R$ 5000 for the current month via the UI. All data stored only in localStorage and was cleared at the end of the run by the Reset flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Always call localStorage.clear() and reload before testing onboarding. Storage key is 'finance_app_state_v1'. Native confirm() is used by Reset — register page.on('dialog', d=>d.accept()) before clicking. Default allocations after onboarding: 20/50/20/10. CATEGORIES ids: investimentos, necessidades, despesas_fixas, lazer. All data-testids listed in the request are present and working.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. The only console-level findings (option-hydration warning, recharts width(-1)) are non-blocking dev-environment artifacts.
